name: odoo-extract
description: Digitize invoices, bank statements, expense reports, and resumes via Odoo's paid OCR/AI Extract API, through the myHub-hosted MCP gateway. Single IAP account token, no OAuth, no per-user credential.

connection.instructions: Nothing to connect — this server authenticates with a single Odoo IAP (In-App Purchase) account token baked into the myHub-hosted MCP gateway's environment, not a per-user credential. Each successful parse spends one credit from that shared account. To (re)provision the token, purchase/top up document-digitization credits in Odoo's IAP service and provide the account token to mySMB ops to register as the ODOO_CLIENT_SECRET secret on myhub-mcp-servers.
